description: This Java class defines a REST controller for managing billing categories in a backend API. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, and updating billing categories, with associated request and response DTOs, and uses Spring annotations for mapping HTTP requests.

classes.name: BillingCategoriesController
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints for listing, creating, and updating billing categories, annotated for API documentation and request validation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list billing categories with their aggregate data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new billing category with validated input.

methods.name: updateRate
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update the hourly rate of a specified billing category.
